professionalScope.en: Continuing professional education for licensed clinicians and allied providers. Every learner gets the same evidence, regulatory status and safety content; what each may do with it — prescribe, recommend, administer, or refer — follows their own licence and scope, and the course adapts its practice guidance to that role. It informs clinical reasoning; it is not a protocol, contains no dosing, and does not replace specialist input, formal guidelines or individual judgment.
professionalScope.id: Pendidikan profesi berkelanjutan untuk klinisi berlisensi dan tenaga kesehatan terkait. Setiap peserta didik mendapatkan bukti, status regulasi, dan materi keselamatan yang sama; apa yang dapat dilakukan masing-masing — meresepkan, merekomendasikan, memberikan, atau merujuk — mengikuti lisensi dan lingkup praktik masing-masing, dan kursus ini menyesuaikan panduan praktiknya dengan peran tersebut. Kursus ini menginformasikan penalaran klinis; ini bukan protokol, tidak memuat dosis, dan tidak menggantikan masukan spesialis, pedoman formal, atau pertimbangan individual.

disclaimers.en: Educational content for clinicians. It does not prescribe, and it never restates an evidence grade above what the source assigns to the specific indication.
disclaimers.id: Materi edukasi untuk klinisi. Materi ini tidak meresepkan, dan tidak pernah menyatakan kembali tingkat bukti di atas apa yang ditetapkan oleh sumber untuk indikasi spesifik tersebut.

disclaimers.en: The source explains US and other countries' rules as comparisons. Indonesia product registration, indication, route and professional-practice status require current checks with BPOM and local review before clinical use.

citations.title: Registered medical product directory (Drug Directory)
citations.publication: EDE online register at services.ede.gov.ae/drugdirectory (embedded at www.ede.gov.ae/en/drug-directory)

note.en: primary regulatory source (register) · issuing authority · role: United Arab Emirates regulatory status · read 2026-09-25 · Searched 25 Sep 2026 by ingredient (IngredientName, substring match) and product name (SearchTerm), e.g. https://services.ede.gov.ae/drugdirectory?IngredientName=semaglutide&ViewMode=list&PageSize=100. Every row returned was 'Active'; the directory has no status filter, so withdrawn or cancelled registrations may not appear. Rows give classification, strength, form, manufacturer, status and registration date; detail pages add dispensing mode and a therapeutic category but no indications. Quotes join table cells with ' | ' and page fields with spaces; '…' marks omitted cells or fields. Searches with no hits: retatrutide, afamelanotide, Scenesse, melanotan, Melanotan, tesamorelin, Tesamorelin, Egrifta, sermorelin, Sermorelin, ipamorelin, Ipamorelin, CJC, CJC-1295, ibutamoren, Ibutamoren, MK-677, BPC-157, BPC 157, pentadecapeptide, TB-500, TB500, thymosin, Thymosin, thymosin beta, KPV, LL-37, cathelicidin, GHK (ingredient and product name), prezatide, copper tripeptide, copper peptide, thymulin, Thymulin, PTD, DBM, PTD-DBM, Zepbound, Loniten, Minoxidil tablet, growth hormone, Skytrofa. 'BPC' as an ingredient matched only two unrelated products whose ingredients carry the 'BPC' pharmacopoeia suffix (Permethrin BPC, Cajuput Oil BPC). 'tripeptide' as an ingredient returned 7 rows: Martiderm anti-hair-loss ampoules, lotion and shampoos (biotinoyl tripeptide-1; GSL products) and the ST500 gel medical device (SH-tripeptide-1).
note.id: sumber regulasi primer (pendaftar/register) · otoritas penerbit · peran: status regulasi Uni Emirat Arab · dibaca 2026-09-25 · Dicari 25 Sep 2026 berdasarkan bahan aktif (IngredientName, pencocokan substring) dan nama produk (SearchTerm), mis. https://services.ede.gov.ae/drugdirectory?IngredientName=semaglutide&ViewMode=list&PageSize=100. Setiap baris yang dihasilkan berstatus 'Active'; direktori tidak memiliki filter status, sehingga registrasi yang ditarik atau dibatalkan mungkin tidak muncul. Baris menampilkan klasifikasi, kekuatan, bentuk, produsen, status, dan tanggal registrasi; halaman rincian menambahkan mode penyerahan (dispensing mode) dan kategori terapeutik tetapi tanpa indikasi. Kutipan menggabungkan sel tabel dengan ' | ' dan bidang halaman dengan spasi; '…' menandai sel atau bidang yang dihilangkan. Pencarian tanpa hasil: retatrutide, afamelanotide, Scenesse, melanotan, Melanotan, tesamorelin, Tesamorelin, Egrifta, sermorelin, Sermorelin, ipamorelin, Ipamorelin, CJC, CJC-1295, ibutamoren, Ibutamoren, MK-677, BPC-157, BPC 157, pentadecapeptide, TB-500, TB500, thymosin, Thymosin, thymosin beta, KPV, LL-37, cathelicidin, GHK (nama bahan dan produk), prezatide, copper tripeptide, copper peptide, thymulin, Thymulin, PTD, DBM, PTD-DBM, Zepbound, Loniten, Minoxidil tablet, growth hormone, Skytrofa. 'BPC' sebagai bahan hanya cocok dengan dua produk tidak terkait yang bahannya memuat sufiks farmakope 'BPC' (Permethrin BPC, Cajuput Oil BPC). 'tripeptide' sebagai bahan menghasilkan 7 baris: ampul, losion, dan sampo anti-rambut-rontok Martiderm (biotinoyl tripeptide-1; produk GSL) serta perangkat medis gel ST500 (SH-tripeptide-1).

citations.title: Infomed – base de dados de medicamentos do Infarmed (pesquisa avançada and 'Detalhes do Medicamento' pages)

note.en: primary regulatory source (register) · issuing authority · role: Portugal regulatory status · read 2026-09-25 · in pt · Searched 25 Sep 2026 with no status filter (so authorised, lapsed, revoked, marketed and non-marketed products all show). Substance (DCI) field matches substrings. Zero-result substance queries: retatrut, retatrutida, retatrutide, tesamorel, tesamorelina, tesamorelin, sermorel, sermorelina, sermorelin, ipamorel, ipamorelina, ipamorelin, CJC, ibutamoren, MK-677, BPC, pentadecapept, timosina, timosina beta, thymosin, KPV, GHK, prezatid, glicil, LL-37, catelicid(ina), ropocamptid, timulina, thymulin, PTD, bremelanot, dermorphin; zero-result name queries: Melanotan, BPC-157, Egrifta, Zepbound. 'melanot' returned only Scenesse (afamelanotido) and Imcivree (setmelanotido); 'cobre' returned only Cuprymina (cloreto de cobre (64Cu), revoked). Positive controls in the same session (semaglut, afamelanot, melanot) returned products. Detail pages opened: Scenesse, Wegovy 0.25 mg/0.38 ml pen, Ozempic 0.25 mg/0.19 ml, Mounjaro 10 mg/0.5 ml, Olumiant 2 mg, Norditropin FlexPro 10 mg/1.5 ml, Propecia 1 mg, Minox 5, Ketrel; dispensing classes for somatropin, semaglutide, tirzepatide, baricitinib, afamelanotide, minoxidil and tretinoin were cross-checked with the 'Classificação Quanto à Dispensa' filter. Row status labels come from Infomed's own tooltips ('Autorizado', 'Caducado', 'Revogado', 'Existe, pelo menos, uma apresentação comercializada.', 'Não existem apresentações comercializadas.'). Infomed's conditions of use ask users to cite it as 'Infomed – base de dados de medicamentos do Infarmed consultada em extranet.infarmed.pt/INFOMED-fo/index.xhtml (acedida em 25/09/2026)' and forbid republishing its content without written authorisation.

Kueri zat aktif dengan hasil nihil: retatrut, retatrutida, retatrutide, tesamorel, tesamorelina, tesamorelin, sermorel, sermorelina, sermorelin, ipamorel, ipamorelina, ipamorelin, CJC, ibutamoren, MK-677, BPC, pentadecapept, timosina, timosina beta, thymosin, KPV, GHK, prezatid, glicil, LL-37, catelicid(ina), ropocamptid, timulina, thymulin, PTD, bremelanot, dermorphin; kueri nama dagang dengan hasil nihil: Melanotan, BPC-157, Egrifta, Zepbound. Kontrol positif pada sesi yang sama (semaglut, afamelanot, melanot) mengembalikan produk. Halaman rincian yang dibuka: Scenesse, Wegovy 0.25 mg/0.38 ml pen, Ozempic 0.25 mg/0.19 ml, Mounjaro 10 mg/0.5 ml, Olumiant 2 mg, Norditropin FlexPro 10 mg/1.5 ml, Propecia 1 mg, Minox 5, Ketrel; kelas penyerahan/dispensing untuk somatropin, semaglutide, tirzepatide, baricitinib, afamelanotide, minoxidil, dan tretinoin dicocokkan silang dengan filter 'Classificação Quanto à Dispensa'. citations.title: Neuro-immuno-endocrinology of the skin: how environment regulates body homeostasis
citations.authors: Slominski RM, Raman C, Jetten AM, Slominski AT

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 1 — the four immuno-endocrine units (epidermal, dermal, hypodermal, adnexal) and the three routes (local, neural, circulation) · PMID 40263492 · Publisher correction PMID 40316721. Guide reference resolves exactly.
note.id: tinjauan naratif · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 6 ref 1 — empat unit imuno-endokrin (epidermal, dermal, hipodermal, adneksa) dan tiga jalur (lokal, neural, sirkulasi) · PMID 40263492 · Koreksi penerbit PMID 40316721. Referensi panduan terkonfirmasi secara tepat.

citations.title: Neuroendocrinology of the skin

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 3, ch.6 ref 3, ch.7 ref 4 — CRH, POMC, ACTH, α-MSH and β-endorphin are made in skin with their receptors (para/autocrine action); dermal and epidermal units · PMID 11041445 · Erratum 2002. Also cited by A&RE ch.7 for the estrogen–senescence statement, which this 2000 review does not address (see findings).
note.id: tinjauan naratif · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 5 ref 3, bab 6 ref 3, bab 7 ref 4 — CRH, POMC, ACTH, α-MSH, dan β-endorfin diproduksi di kulit beserta reseptornya (kerja para/autokrin); unit dermal dan epidermal · PMID 11041445 · Eratum 2002. Juga disitasi oleh A&RE bab 7 untuk pernyataan estrogen–senesens, yang tidak dibahas dalam tinjauan tahun 2000 ini (lihat temuan).

citations.title: The human skin as a hormone target and an endocrine gland

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 4, ch.7 ref 2 — skin makes, activates and releases hormones, including sex steroids that matter for the whole organism, especially in older people · PMID 16982574 · Verified; no PMCID.
note.id: tinjauan naratif · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 5 ref 4, bab 7 ref 2 — kulit memproduksi, mengaktivasi, dan melepaskan hormon, termasuk steroid seks yang penting bagi seluruh organisme, terutama pada orang lanjut usia · PMID 16982574 · Terverifikasi; tidak ada PMCID.

citations.title: Neuronal control of skin function: the skin as a neuroimmunoendocrine organ
citations.authors: Roosterman D, Goerge T, Schneider SW, Bunnett NW, Steinhoff M

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 13 — sensory nerves and neuropeptides as the neural arm of the skin's signalling network · PMID 17015491 · Verified.
note.id: tinjauan naratif · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 5 ref 13 — saraf sensorik dan neuropeptida sebagai lengan neural dari jaringan persinyalan kulit · PMID 17015491 · Terverifikasi.

citations.title: Steroidogenesis in the skin: implications for local immune functions
citations.authors: Slominski A, Zbytek B, Nikolakis G, et al.

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 4 — skin cells hold the full apparatus (CYP11A1 onward) to make glucocorticoids, androgens and estrogens or activate circulating precursors; the review also describes a skin contribution to circulating androgens and estrogens · PMID 23435015 · Verified.
note.id: tinjauan naratif · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 6 ref 4 — sel-sel kulit memiliki aparatus lengkap (dari CYP11A1 dan seterusnya) untuk memproduksi glukokortikoid, androgen, dan estrogen atau mengaktivasi prekursor yang bersirkulasi; tinjauan ini juga menjelaskan kontribusi kulit terhadap androgen dan estrogen yang bersirkulasi · PMID 23435015 · Terverifikasi.

citations.title: Keratinocytes control skin immune homeostasis through de novo-synthesized glucocorticoids
citations.authors: Phan TS, Schink L, Mann J, et al.

note.en: mouse genetic model (keratinocyte Cyp11b1 deletion) plus human disease association · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 5 — keratinocyte-made glucocorticoids restrain skin inflammation; the functional proof is in mice · PMID 33514551 · The guide presents this without naming the species; the course labels it as animal evidence.
note.id: model genetik mencit (delesi Cyp11b1 keratinosit) ditambah asosiasi penyakit manusia · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 6 ref 5 — glukokortikoid yang diproduksi keratinosit meredam inflamasi kulit; bukti fungsional ada pada mencit · PMID 33514551 · Panduan menyajikan hal ini tanpa menyebutkan spesiesnya; kursus melabelinya sebagai bukti pada hewan.

citations.title: Human hair follicles display a functional equivalent of the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis and synthesize cortisol
citations.authors: Ito N, Ito T, Kromminga A, et al.

note.en: human scalp hair follicles in organ culture (ex vivo) · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 11 — CRH → POMC/ACTH → cortisol secretion with glucocorticoid feedback on CRH, in follicles with no systemic connections · PMID 15946990 · Verified.
note.id: folikel rambut kulit kepala manusia dalam kultur organ (ex vivo) · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 6 ref 11 — CRH → POMC/ACTH → sekresi kortisol dengan umpan balik glukokortikoid terhadap CRH, pada folikel tanpa koneksi sistemik · PMID 15946990 · Terverifikasi.

citations.title: Human Hair Follicles Operate a Functional Peripheral Equivalent of the Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Somatotropic Axis Ex Vivo
citations.authors: Horesh EJ, Gherardini J, Alam M, et al.

note.en: research letter; human follicles ex vivo · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 12 — a GH/IGF-1 loop in the follicle · PMID 36496194 · No abstract indexed and not open access; cited only for the finding its title states.
note.id: research letter; folikel manusia ex vivo · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 6 ref 12 — loop GH/IGF-1 di dalam folikel · PMID 36496194 · Tidak ada abstrak yang terindeks dan bukan akses terbuka; disitasi hanya untuk temuan yang dinyatakan dalam judulnya.

citations.title: Thyroid hormone action in epidermal development and homeostasis and its implications in the pathophysiology of the skin
citations.authors: Mancino G, Miro C, Di Cicco E, Dentice M

note.en: narrative review (mouse models of thyroid-hormone metabolism) · academic · role: A&RE ch.6 ref 7 — local deiodinase control of T3 in keratinocytes; the review says the mechanisms are being clarified mainly in mouse models · PMID 33683663 · Verified.
note.id: tinjauan naratif (model mencit untuk metabolisme hormon tiroid) · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 6 ref 7 — kontrol deiodinase lokal terhadap T3 pada keratinosit; tinjauan menyatakan mekanisme ini terutama sedang diperjelas pada model mencit · PMID 33683663 · Terverifikasi.

citations.title: Photosynthesis of previtamin D3 in human skin and the physiologic consequences
citations.authors: Holick MF, MacLaughlin JA, Clark MB, et al.

note.en: human skin photobiology · academic · role: the skin-to-body example: previtamin D3 forms in human skin under solar UV and vitamin D3 is carried into the circulation by vitamin D-binding protein · PMID 6251551 · Not cited by either guide; added as the primary for the statement that skin supplies a whole-body hormone system.
note.id: fotobiologi kulit manusia · akademis · peran: contoh kulit-ke-tubuh (skin-to-body): previtamin D3 terbentuk di kulit manusia di bawah sinar UV matahari dan vitamin D3 dibawa ke sirkulasi oleh protein pengikat vitamin D (vitamin D-binding protein) · PMID 6251551 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan; ditambahkan sebagai sumber primer untuk pernyataan bahwa kulit menyuplai sistem hormon ke seluruh tubuh.

citations.title: Vitamin D metabolism, mechanism of action, and clinical applications

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: A&RE ch.7 ref 3 — vitamin D3 made in skin from 7-dehydrocholesterol, then 25(OH)D and 1,25(OH)2D elsewhere · PMID 24529992 · Verified.
note.id: tinjauan naratif · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 7 ref 3 — vitamin D3 diproduksi di kulit dari 7-dehidrokolesterol, kemudian 25(OH)D dan 1,25(OH)2D di tempat lain · PMID 24529992 · Terverifikasi.

citations.title: Thyroid hormone action on skin

note.en: clinical review · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 8 — the skin signs of thyroid disease (myxoedema; dry, coarse skin) · PMID 22110782 · Verified (a 2012 review with the same title exists, PMID 22914563; the guide's volume and pages match this one).
note.id: tinjauan klinis · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 5 ref 8 — tanda-tanda kulit pada penyakit tiroid (miksedema; kulit kering dan kasar) · PMID 22110782 · Terverifikasi (ada tinjauan tahun 2012 dengan judul yang sama, PMID 22914563; volume dan halaman panduan cocok dengan yang ini).

citations.title: A Hormone Cell Atlas maps the human endocrine system at cellular resolution
citations.authors: Fei L, Huang-Doran I, Lawler K, et al. (senior authors Teichmann SA, Farooqi IS)

note.en: single-cell and single-nucleus transcriptomic atlas (hormone2cell): 379 hormone and receptor genes, ~14 million cells and nuclei, 47 human tissues · academic (University of Cambridge, Wellcome Sanger Institute) · role: A&RE ch.7 ref 1 — predicted hormone-producing and hormone-receiving cell types; the transcriptomic map the lesson is about · PMID 42207862 · PubMed entry 2026-05-28 (the guide's 'published online May 28, 2026'); print issue 2 Jul 2026. Full text and supplement paywalled (HTTP 403); only abstract- and portal-level facts are taught.
note.id: atlas transkriptomik sel-tunggal dan nukleus-tunggal (hormone2cell): 379 gen hormon dan reseptor, ~14 juta sel dan nukleus, 47 jaringan manusia · akademis (University of Cambridge, Wellcome Sanger Institute) · peran: A&RE bab 7 ref 1 — prediksi tipe sel penghasil hormon dan penerima hormon; peta transkriptomik yang dibahas dalam materi · PMID 42207862 · Entri PubMed 2026-05-28 (panduan menyebutkan 'published online May 28, 2026'); edisi cetak 2 Jul 2026. Teks lengkap dan suplemen berbayar/paywalled (HTTP 403); hanya fakta tingkat abstrak dan portal yang diajarkan.

citations.title: Hormone Cell Atlas portal — About and FAQs
citations.authors: Hormone Cell Atlas team (Farooqi and Teichmann groups)

note.en: data portal · atlas authors · role: the authors' own usage statement: predictions are 'putative and hypothesis-generating, rather than … functional hormones and receptors', validation is the user's responsibility; 47 disease-free tissues, 1,900+ cell types, 14 million+ cells; skin is listed among the tissues on the sister cellxgene site (hormonecellatlas.cellgeni.sanger.ac.uk) · Fetched live 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200).
note.id: portal data · penulis atlas · peran: pernyataan penggunaan dari penulis sendiri: prediksi bersifat 'putatif dan menghasilkan hipotesis, bukan … hormon dan reseptor fungsional', validasi merupakan tanggung jawab pengguna; 47 jaringan bebas penyakit, 1.900+ tipe sel, 14 juta+ sel; kulit tercantum di antara jaringan pada situs web saudara cellxgene (hormonecellatlas.cellgeni.sanger.ac.uk) · Diambil langsung secara daring 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200).

citations.title: On the Dependency of Cellular Protein Levels on mRNA Abundance
citations.authors: Liu Y, Beyer A, Aebersold R

note.en: narrative review · academic · role: transcript levels by themselves are not sufficient to predict protein levels in many scenarios · PMID 27104977 · Not cited by either guide; added to support the RNA-versus-protein step.
note.id: tinjauan naratif · akademis · peran: kadar transkrip saja tidak cukup untuk memprediksi kadar protein dalam banyak skenario · PMID 27104977 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan; ditambahkan untuk mendukung langkah perbandingan RNA versus protein.

citations.title: The effect of sunscreen on vitamin D: a review
citations.authors: Neale RE, Khan SR, Lucas RM, Waterhouse M, Whiteman DC, Olsen CM

note.en: systematic review (MOOSE): 4 experimental studies, 3 field trials (2 RCTs), 69 observational studies · academic (QIMR Berghofer, Australian National University) · role: tests the guide's pearl that serum 25(OH)D falls with sunscreen use: experiments with artificial UV show a block; randomized field trials of daily sunscreen (SPF ~16) show no fall; high-SPF products untested · PMID 30945275 · Not cited by either guide; contradicts A&RE ch.7 testing pearl (see findings).
note.id: tinjauan sistematis (MOOSE): 4 studi eksperimental, 3 uji lapangan (2 RCT), 69 studi observasional · akademis (QIMR Berghofer, Australian National University) · peran: menguji clinical pearl panduan bahwa 25(OH)D serum turun akibat penggunaan tabir surya: eksperimen dengan UV artifisial menunjukkan adanya hambatan; uji lapangan teracak dari tabir surya harian (SPF ~16) tidak menunjukkan penurunan; produk ber-SPF tinggi belum diuji · PMID 30945275 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan; bertentangan dengan clinical pearl pengujian A&RE bab 7 (lihat temuan).

citations.title: Senescence-associated secretory phenotypes reveal cell-nonautonomous functions of oncogenic RAS and the p53 tumor suppressor
citations.authors: Coppé JP, Patil CK, Rodier F, et al.

note.en: cultured human fibroblasts and epithelial cells after genotoxic stress (+ prostate tumours after chemotherapy) · academic · role: defines the SASP (IL-6, IL-8 and other secreted factors) — the concept the guide uses · PMID 19053174 · Not cited by either guide; the primary behind 'SASP'.

citations.authors: Ressler S, Bartkova J, Niederegger H, et al.

note.en: human skin tissue bank, cross-sectional (0–20, 21–70, 71–95 years) · academic · role: p16-positive cells are more numerous in older skin, in both epidermis and dermis · PMID 16911562 · Not cited by either guide.
note.id: bank jaringan kulit manusia, potong-lintang (0–20, 21–70, 71–95 tahun) · akademis · peran: sel p16-positif lebih banyak ditemukan pada kulit yang lebih tua, baik di epidermis maupun dermis · PMID 16911562 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan.

citations.title: P16INK4a Positive Cells in Human Skin Are Indicative of Local Elastic Fiber Morphology, Facial Wrinkling, and Perceived Age
citations.authors: Waaijer ME, Gunn DA, Adams PD, et al.
citations.publication: J Gerontol A Biol Sci Med Sci · 2016;71:1022–1028

note.en: cohort (Leiden Longevity Study), n=178, aged 45–81, sun-protected upper-inner-arm biopsies · academic; one co-author from Unilever; NIH and Cancer Research UK grants · role: senescent-cell counts in human skin track with elastic-fibre changes, facial wrinkles and perceived age, independent of chronological age; lowest vs highest tertile of epidermal p16 counts looked ~3 years younger · PMID 26286607 · Not cited by either guide.
note.id: kohort (Leiden Longevity Study), n=178, usia 45–81 tahun, biopsi lengan atas bagian dalam yang terlindung dari sinar matahari · akademis; satu rekan penulis dari Unilever; hibah NIH dan Cancer Research UK · peran: jumlah sel senesen pada kulit manusia berkorelasi dengan perubahan serat elastis, kerutan wajah, dan persepsi usia, terlepas dari usia kronologis; tertil terendah vs tertinggi dari hitung p16 epidermis tampak ~3 tahun lebih muda · PMID 26286607 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan.

citations.title: Faces of cellular senescence in skin aging

citations.title: Biomarkers of Cellular Senescence and Skin Aging

citations.authors: Haykal D, Flament F, Garibyan L, Lee K, Escot J, Gueniche A, Kirkland J

note.en: narrative review (no new data) · three authors from L'Oréal and a senolytic-field investigator; declares no competing interests · role: how dermatologic senotherapy stands in 2026: a review of mechanism and prospects; transient senescence aids wound repair · PMID 42417965 · Not cited by either guide.
note.id: tinjauan naratif (tanpa data baru) · tiga penulis dari L'Oréal dan seorang peneliti bidang senolitik; menyatakan tidak ada konflik kepentingan · peran: status senoterapi dermatologis pada tahun 2026: tinjauan mekanisme dan prospek; senesensi transien membantu perbaikan luka · PMID 42417965 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan.

citations.title: The influence of age and sex on skin thickness, skin collagen and density
citations.authors: Shuster S, Black MM, McVitie E

note.en: cross-sectional reference measurements of forearm skin · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 1 — skin collagen falls with age and is lower in women at all ages · PMID 1220811 · The abstract gives no annual rate; the guide's '~1% per year' could not be checked and is not taught.
note.id: pengukuran referensi potong-lintang pada kulit lengan bawah · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 5 ref 1 — kolagen kulit menurun seiring bertambahnya usia dan lebih rendah pada wanita di semua kelompok usia · PMID 1220811 · Abstrak tidak mencantumkan laju tahunan; angka '~1% per tahun' dari panduan tidak dapat diverifikasi dan tidak diajarkan.

citations.title: Decreased collagen production in chronologically aged skin: roles of age-dependent alteration in fibroblast function and defective mechanical stimulation
citations.authors: Varani J, Dame MK, Rittie L, et al.

note.en: human skin sections (18–29 vs 80+ years) and isolated dermal fibroblasts · academic · role: aged fibroblasts make less procollagen and are less attached to and stretched by collagen — two routes to lower synthesis · PMID 16723701 · Not cited by either guide.
note.id: irisan jaringan kulit manusia (18–29 vs 80+ tahun) dan fibroblas dermis terisolasi · akademis · peran: fibroblas yang menua menghasilkan lebih sedikit prokolagen serta kurang melekat pada dan kurang teregang oleh kolagen — dua jalur menuju penurunan sintesis · PMID 16723701 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan.

citations.title: Collagen fragmentation promotes oxidative stress and elevates matrix metalloproteinase-1 in fibroblasts in aged human skin
citations.authors: Fisher GJ, Quan T, Purohit T, et al.

note.en: aged (>80) vs young (21–30) human skin in vivo, plus organ and collagen-lattice culture · academic · role: more fibroblast MMP-1 in aged human dermis; fragmented collagen lowers fibroblast stretch and raises MMP-1 and oxidants — a self-perpetuating loop · PMID 19116368 · Not cited by either guide.
note.id: kulit manusia usia lanjut (>80) vs muda (21–30) in vivo, ditambah kultur organ dan matriks kisi kolagen · akademis · peran: MMP-1 fibroblas lebih tinggi pada dermis manusia yang menua; kolagen yang terfragmentasi menurunkan peregangan fibroblas serta meningkatkan MMP-1 dan oksidan — suatu lingkaran yang berulang terus-menerus · PMID 19116368 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan.

citations.title: Mechanisms of photoaging and chronological skin aging
citations.authors: Fisher GJ, Kang S, Varani J, et al.

note.en: narrative review with new data · academic · role: A&RE ch.5 ref 2 — UV drives the matrix breakdown of photoageing, and photoageing and chronological ageing share molecular pathways · PMID 12437452 · Verified.
note.id: tinjauan naratif dengan data baru · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 5 ref 2 — UV mendorong degradasi matriks pada photoageing, dan photoageing serta penuaan kronologis memiliki jalur molekuler yang serupa · PMID 12437452 · Terverifikasi.

citations.title: Naturally occurring p16(Ink4a)-positive cells shorten healthy lifespan
citations.authors: Baker DJ, Childs BG, Durik M, et al.

note.en: mouse (INK-ATTAC transgene) · academic · role: A&RE ch.13 ref 2 — clearing p16-positive cells from one year of age extended median lifespan and delayed kidney, heart and fat deterioration; skin was checked for safety only (thickness, fibrosis), and clearance during healing slowed wound closure (Extended Data Fig. 10) · PMID 26840489 · Verified.
note.id: mencit (transgen INK-ATTAC) · akademis · peran: A&RE bab 13 ref 2 — pembersihan sel p16-positif sejak usia satu tahun memperpanjang median masa hidup dan menunda perburukan ginjal, jantung, dan jaringan lemak; kulit hanya diperiksa untuk keamanan (ketebalan, fibrosis), dan pembersihan selama penyembuhan memperlambat penutupan luka (Extended Data Gbr. 10) · PMID 26840489 · Terverifikasi.

citations.title: Senolytics improve physical function and increase lifespan in old age
citations.authors: Xu M, Pirtskhalava T, Farr JN, et al.

note.en: mouse, plus human adipose-tissue explants · several authors hold a financial interest; Mayo Clinic holds senolytic patents · role: A&RE ch.17 ref 1 — senescent cells cause dysfunction when transplanted; senolytics improved function and post-treatment survival in old mice · PMID 29988130 · Verified.

citations.title: Senolytics decrease senescent cells in humans: Preliminary report from a clinical trial of Dasatinib plus Quercetin in individuals with diabetic kidney disease
citations.authors: Hickson LJ, Langhi Prata LGP, Bobart SA, et al.

note.en: open-label phase 1 pilot, n=9, diabetic kidney disease (NCT02848131) · investigators with a financial interest; Mayo Clinic holds patents · role: A&RE ch.17 ref 3 — after a short course, epidermal p16- and p21-positive cells and circulating SASP factors fell; tissue-marker endpoints only · PMID 31542391 · Corrigendum PMID 31982828. The course does not report doses.
note.id: studi percontohan (pilot) fase 1 label-terbuka, n=9, penyakit ginjal diabetik (NCT02848131) · peneliti dengan kepentingan finansial; Mayo Clinic memegang paten · peran: A&RE bab 17 ref 3 — setelah satu rangkaian pengobatan singkat, sel epidermis p16- dan p21-positif serta faktor SASP sirkulasi menurun; luaran hanya berupa penanda jaringan · PMID 31542391 · Corrigendum PMID 31982828. citations.title: Topical rapamycin reduces markers of senescence and aging in human skin: an exploratory, prospective, randomized trial
citations.authors: Chung CL, Lawrence I, Hoffman M, et al.

note.id: RCT eksploratori terkontrol plasebo; 36 terdaftar, 19 menghentikan keikutsertaan atau hilang dari pemantauan (NCT03103893) · akademis (Drexel University) · peran: satu-satunya studi teracak mengenai senomorfik pada kulit manusia menemukan: protein p16 menurun dan kolagen VII meningkat; perubahan klinis hanya dilaporkan pada 'sejumlah peserta' · PMID 31761958 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan.

citations.title: Sunscreen and prevention of skin aging: a randomized trial
citations.authors: Hughes MC, Williams GM, Baker P, Green AC

note.en: community RCT (Nambour), n=903 adults under 55, 4.5 years, blinded assessors (ACTRN12610000086066) · public (National Health and Medical Research Council of Australia) · role: daily sunscreen: no detectable increase in skin ageing over 4.5 years and 24% less ageing than discretionary use · PMID 23732711 · Not cited by either guide (A&RE ch.10 recommends sun protection without a trial citation).
note.id: RCT berbasis komunitas (Nambour), n=903 dewasa berusia di bawah 55 tahun, 4,5 tahun, penilai tersamar (ACTRN12610000086066) · publik (National Health and Medical Research Council of Australia) · peran: tabir surya harian: tidak ada peningkatan penuaan kulit yang terdeteksi selama 4,5 tahun dan penuaan 24% lebih rendah dibandingkan penggunaan diskresioner · PMID 23732711 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan (A&RE bab 10 merekomendasikan perlindungan matahari tanpa menyitasi uji klinis).

citations.title: Topical tretinoin for treating photoaging: A systematic review of randomized controlled trials
citations.authors: Sitohang IBS, Makes WI, Sandora N, Suryanegara J

note.en: systematic review of 7 RCTs · academic; no conflicts declared · role: the randomized-trial base behind the guide's GRADE A for topical retinoids in photoageing: consistent improvement in wrinkling, mottled pigmentation and lentigines · PMID 35620028 · A&RE gives no citation for its GRADE A; this review supplies one.

citations.title: Improvement of naturally aged skin with vitamin A (retinol)
citations.authors: Kafi R, Kwak HS, Schumacher WE, et al.

note.en: randomized double-blind vehicle-controlled arm comparison, n=36, mean age 87, 24 weeks · academic (NIH-supported) · role: retinol improved fine wrinkling of naturally aged skin; biopsy subgroups showed more glycosaminoglycan and procollagen I · PMID 17515510 · Not cited by either guide. Concentrations are not reported by the course.
note.id: perbandingan lengan teracak tersamar ganda terkontrol vehikulum, n=36, usia rata-rata 87 tahun, 24 minggu · akademis (didukung NIH) · peran: retinol memperbaiki kerutan halus pada kulit yang menua secara alami; subkelompok biopsi menunjukkan peningkatan glikosaminoglikan dan prokolagen I · PMID 17515510 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan. Konsentrasi tidak dilaporkan oleh modul ini.

citations.title: Vitamin A antagonizes decreased cell growth and elevated collagen-degrading matrix metalloproteinases and stimulates collagen accumulation in naturally aged human skin
citations.authors: Varani J, Warner RL, Gharaee-Kermani M, et al.

Concentrations are not reported by the course.
note.id: kulit manusia yang terlindung dari sinar matahari berdasarkan kelompok usia (n=72) ditambah retinol topikal selama satu minggu pada 53 orang berusia 80+ tahun · akademis · peran: kulit yang menua menunjukkan MMP lebih tinggi dan sintesis kolagen lebih rendah; pemakaian retinol topikal selama satu minggu menurunkan MMP dan meningkatkan sintesis kolagen · PMID 10692106 · Tidak disitasi oleh kedua panduan. citations.title: Localization, age- and site-dependent expression, and regulation of 11β-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 in skin

note.id: eksplan kulit manusia dan fibroblas dermis primer; kulit mencit · akademis (University of Birmingham) · peran: keratinosit dan fibroblas dermis mengekspresikan 11β-HSD1 (bukan 11β-HSD2); aktivitas meningkat seiring bertambahnya usia donor; fibroblas yang terpapar sinar matahari mengekspresikan lebih banyak; ketersediaan glukokortikoid diatur pada tingkat pra-reseptor, terlepas dari kadar sistemik · PMID 20739946 · A&RE bab 8 ref 2; terverifikasi

citations.title: 11β-Hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase blockade prevents age-induced skin structure and function defects
citations.authors: Tiganescu A, Tahrani AA, Morgan SA, et al.

note.id: biopsi kulit manusia (muda vs lebih tua; terpapar sinar matahari vs terlindung dari sinar matahari) + mencit knockout 11β-HSD1 · akademis (University of Birmingham) · peran: aktivitas 11β-HSD1 meningkat pada kulit manusia yang menua dan terpapar sinar matahari; mencit knockout terlindung dari atrofi dermis akibat penuaan; kortisol fisiologis menghambat biosintesis kolagen pada fibroblas dermis · PMID 23722901 · tidak disitasi oleh panduan; akses terbuka PMC3696573

citations.title: Oral 11β-HSD1 inhibitor AZD4017 improves wound healing and skin integrity in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus: a pilot randomized controlled trial
citations.authors: Ajjan RA, Hensor EMA, Del Galdo F, et al.

note.id: pilot fase 2b tersamar ganda terkontrol-plasebo terinisiasi-peneliti, n=28 dewasa dengan diabetes tipe 2, 35 hari · pimpinan akademik (University of Leeds); rekan penulis AstraZeneca · peran: satu-satunya RCT pada manusia terkait inhibisi 11β-HSD1 dengan luaran kulit: luaran primer (aktivitas 11β-HSD1 kulit ex vivo) tidak tercapai; diameter luka eksploratif lebih kecil; integritas epidermal membaik tetapi fungsi sawar sedikit terganggu · PMID 35113805 · tidak disitasi oleh panduan; terdaftar NCT03313297; rejimen obat sengaja tidak dicantumkan ulang (penguncian mengecualikan dosis)

citations.title: Glucocorticoids and Skin Healing in Diabetes (GC-SHealD)

note.en: registered phase 2 pilot · academic · role: status: the only registered trial of an 11β-HSD1 inhibitor with skin outcomes found (ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API, 2026-09-24, terms '11beta-HSD1', '11-beta hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 inhibitor', AZD4017, SPI-62, clofutriben); none tests skin ageing. AZD4017 has no Drugs@FDA record (openFDA drugsfda query, 2026-09-24) · CT.gov API 2026-09-24; results published as Ajjan 2022
note.id: pilot fase 2 terdaftar · akademik · peran: status: satu-satunya uji klinis terdaftar untuk penghambat 11β-HSD1 dengan luaran kulit yang ditemukan (ClinicalTrials.gov v2 API, 2026-09-24, istilah '11beta-HSD1', '11-beta hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 1 inhibitor', AZD4017, SPI-62, clofutriben); tidak ada yang menguji penuaan kulit. AZD4017 tidak memiliki catatan Drugs@FDA (kueri drugsfda openFDA, 2026-09-24) · API CT.gov 2026-09-24; hasil dipublikasikan sebagai Ajjan 2022

citations.title: The diagnosis of Cushing's syndrome: an Endocrine Society Clinical Practice Guideline
citations.authors: Nieman LK, Biller BMK, Findling JW, et al.

note.en: clinical practice guideline (GRADE) · professional society (Endocrine Society) · role: A&RE ch.8 ref 5. Table 1: features that best discriminate Cushing's syndrome = easy bruising, facial plethora, proximal myopathy, striae (especially reddish-purple and >1 cm wide); common and/or less discriminatory = facial fullness, dorsocervical fat pad, supraclavicular fullness, weight gain, obesity, acne, hirsutism, thin skin, fatigue, insomnia. 3.1 drug history first (oral, rectal, inhaled, topical, injected; skin creams incl. bleaching agents, herbal tonics, joint or nerve injections). 3.2 test multiple and progressive features or features unusual for age. 3.3 against widespread testing. 3.5 against random serum cortisol. Abnormal result → endocrinologist. Endogenous incidence 2–3 per million per year (European population studies); commonest cause iatrogenic. · PMID 18334580 · full text read at pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov (PMC2386281) 2026-09-24; test names only, doses not reproduced
note.id: panduan praktik klinis (GRADE) · perhimpunan profesi (Endocrine Society) · peran: A&RE bab 8 ref 5. Tabel 1: gambaran klinis yang paling mendiskriminasi sindrom Cushing = mudah memar, pletora wajah, miopati proksimal, striae (terutama ungu kemerahan dan lebar >1 cm); umum dan/atau kurang diskriminatif = wajah membulat (facial fullness), bantalan lemak dorsoservikal, kepenuhan supraklavikula, penambahan berat badan, obesitas, akne, hirsutisme, kulit tipis, kelelahan, insomnia. 3.1 riwayat pengobatan terlebih dahulu (oral, rektal, inhalasi, topikal, injeksi; krim kulit termasuk zat pemutih, tonik herbal, injeksi sendi atau saraf). 3.2 uji fitur multipel dan progresif atau fitur yang tidak lazim untuk usia tersebut. 3.3 tidak merekomendasikan pengujian secara luas. 3.5 tidak merekomendasikan kortisol serum sewaktu. Hasil abnormal → endokrinologis. Insidensi endogen 2–3 per juta per tahun (studi populasi Eropa); penyebab paling sering adalah iatrogenik. · PMID 18334580 · teks lengkap dibaca di pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov (PMC2386281) 2026-09-24; nama pemeriksaan saja, dosis tidak dicantumkan ulang

citations.title: Estrogens and aging skin

citations.authors: Rittié L, Kang S, Voorhees JJ, Fisher GJ

citations.title: Long-term effects of the menopause and sex hormones on skin thickness
citations.authors: Brincat M, Moniz CJ, Studd JW, et al.

note.id: studi observasional pada wanita pascamenopause · akademik (London) · peran: kandungan kolagen kulit, ketebalan kulit, dan massa tulang masing-masing menurun sebesar 1–2% per tahun setelah menopause, berkorelasi dengan tahun sejak menopause · PMID 3120067 · sumber primer untuk angka per tahun tersebut

citations.authors: Affinito P, Palomba S, Sorrentino C, et al.

citations.title: Understanding Unapproved Use of Approved Drugs "Off Label"

note.en: regulatory page · regulator · role: 'off-label' means unapproved use of an approved drug; once FDA approves a drug, healthcare providers generally may prescribe it for an unapproved use when they judge it medically appropriate · fetched 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200)
note.id: halaman regulasi · regulator · peran: 'off-label' berarti penggunaan obat yang telah disetujui untuk indikasi yang belum disetujui; setelah FDA menyetujui suatu obat, penyedia layanan kesehatan umumnya dapat meresepkannya untuk penggunaan yang belum disetujui jika mereka menilainya tepat secara medis · diambil 2026-09-24 (HTTP 200)

citations.title: Good practice in proposing, prescribing, providing and managing medicines and devices — Prescribing unlicensed medicines (paragraphs 102–108)
citations.publication: gmc-uk.org · in effect 5 April 2021, updated 15 March 2022 and 13 December 2024

note.en: professional standard · statutory professional regulator · role: UK doctors: GMC uses 'unlicensed medicine' for medicines used outside their UK licence or with no UK licence (102); usually prescribe licensed medicines within their licence (103); when prescribing an unlicensed medicine, be satisfied there is sufficient evidence or experience of safety and efficacy, take responsibility for prescribing and for overseeing care, monitoring and follow-up, and record the reasons where not following common practice (105); explain to the patient, with reasons, when use is not routine or licensed alternatives exist (108) · Read in a browser 2026-09-25; gmc-uk.org answers scripts with HTTP 403, so the automated source check cannot read it.
note.id: standar profesional · regulator profesi menurut undang-undang · peran: Dokter UK: GMC menggunakan istilah 'unlicensed medicine' untuk obat yang digunakan di luar izin edar UK atau tanpa izin edar UK (102); biasanya meresepkan obat berizin edar sesuai indikasi izinnya (103); saat meresepkan obat tanpa izin edar (unlicensed), harus yakin terdapat bukti atau pengalaman yang memadai mengenai keamanan dan efikasinya, bertanggung jawab atas peresepan serta pengawasan perawatan, pemantauan, dan tindak lanjut, serta mencatat alasannya jika tidak mengikuti praktik umum (105); menjelaskan kepada pasien, disertai alasan, apabila penggunaannya bukan merupakan hal rutin atau jika terdapat alternatif berizin edar (108) · Dibaca di peramban 2026-09-25; gmc-uk.org merespons skrip dengan HTTP 403, sehingga pemeriksaan sumber otomatis tidak dapat membacanya.

citations.title: In practice: Guidance for pharmacist prescribers (updated April 2025)

note.en: professional standard · statutory professional regulator · role: UK pharmacist prescribers: a pharmacist independent prescriber may prescribe any medicine for any condition within their scope and competence (exceptions: three controlled drugs for addiction and initiating unlicensed cannabis-based products); for an unlicensed or off-label medicine they must be sure of sufficient evidence and experience of its safety and effectiveness, and record discussions and the reasons for prescribing decisions · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200). note.id: standar profesional · regulator profesi menurut undang-undang · peran: Apoteker peresep UK: apoteker peresep independen (pharmacist independent prescriber) dapat meresepkan obat apa pun untuk kondisi apa pun dalam ruang lingkup dan kompetensinya (pengecualian: tiga obat terkontrol untuk adiksi dan inisiasi produk berbasis kanabis tanpa izin edar); untuk obat tanpa izin edar (unlicensed) atau off-label, mereka harus yakin akan kecukupan bukti dan pengalaman mengenai keamanan dan efektivitasnya, serta mencatat diskusi dan alasan keputusan peresepan · Diambil langsung dan dibaca 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200). citations.title: The Code: professional standards of practice and behaviour for nurses, midwives and nursing associates — standard 18

note.en: professional standard · statutory professional regulator · role: UK nurses and midwives: advise on, prescribe, supply, dispense or administer medicines within the limits of training and competence, the law, NMC guidance and other relevant policies (18); prescribe only with enough knowledge of the person's health and when satisfied the treatment serves their health needs (18.1); only registrants with a recorded prescribing qualification may prescribe · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200).
note.id: standar profesional · regulator profesi menurut undang-undang · peran: Perawat dan bidan UK: memberikan saran, meresepkan, memasok, mengeluarkan, atau memberikan obat dalam batas pelatihan dan kompetensi, hukum, panduan NMC, serta kebijakan relevan lainnya (18); meresepkan hanya dengan pengetahuan yang memadai mengenai kesehatan pasien dan jika yakin pengobatan tersebut memenuhi kebutuhan kesehatan mereka (18.1); hanya pendaftar dengan kualifikasi peresepan tercatat yang boleh meresepkan · Diambil langsung dan dibaca 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200).

citations.authors: Committee of Advertising Practice / Advertising Standards Authority

note.en: advertising code · self-regulatory body backed by statutory referral · role: UK advertising: objective claims must be backed by evidence, where relevant trials on people (12.1); medicines must hold a licence before they are marketed (12.11); prescription-only medicines or prescription-only medical treatments may not be advertised to the public (12.12) · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200).
note.id: kode etik periklanan · badan swaregulasi yang didukung rujukan undang-undang · peran: Periklanan UK: klaim objektif harus didukung oleh bukti, jika relevan berupa uji klinis pada manusia (12.1); obat harus memiliki izin edar sebelum dipasarkan (12.11); obat keras (prescription-only medicine) atau tindakan medis berbasis obat keras tidak boleh diiklankan kepada masyarakat umum (12.12) · Diambil langsung dan dibaca 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200).

citations.authors: Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (UK)

note.en: regulator guidance · regulator · role: UK advertising: medicinal products without a valid licence may not be advertised (regulation 279, s. 4.2); specials suppliers may not advertise specific unlicensed products; clinics may promote their service, e.g. 'treatment for lines and wrinkles', but must not name prescription-only products such as 'Botox' (s. 7.3); in treatment-service websites and social media, unlicensed medicines should not be mentioned, treatments using them may not be called 'clinically proven', and naming a prescription-only medicine in a clinic's social media is likely to be a prohibited advertisement (Appendix 6) · Fetched live and read 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200). note.id: panduan regulator · regulator · peran: Periklanan UK: produk obat tanpa izin edar yang valid tidak boleh diiklankan (regulation 279, s. 4.2); pemasok formula khusus (specials) tidak boleh mengiklankan produk tanpa izin edar tertentu; klinik boleh mempromosikan layanannya, mis. 'perawatan garis halus dan kerutan', tetapi tidak boleh menyebutkan nama produk obat keras seperti 'Botox' (s. 7.3); pada situs web layanan tindakan dan media sosial, obat tanpa izin edar tidak boleh disebutkan, tindakan yang menggunakannya tidak boleh diklaim 'terbukti secara klinis', dan menyebutkan nama obat keras di media sosial klinik berkemungkinan merupakan iklan yang dilarang (Lampiran 6) · Diambil langsung dan dibaca 2026-09-25 (HTTP 200). claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Oestrogel® é indicado para o tratamento de sinais e sintomas oriundos da deficiência estrogênica relacionados à menopausa natural ou cirúrgica (fogachos, atrofia urogenital, distúrbio no sono e astenia) e prevenção da osteoporose (perda óssea) pós-menopausa." (English: "Oestrogel® is indicated for the treatment of signs and symptoms of oestrogen deficiency related to natural or surgical menopause (hot flushes, urogenital atrophy, sleep disturbance and asthenia) and for prevention of postmenopausal osteoporosis (bone loss).") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, oral collagen is regulated as a food supplement, not a medicine; ANVISA's Jan 2025 guidance lists an approved skin-health claim for 2 kDa bioactive collagen peptides, restricted to products meeting an ANVISA-set minimum content, for adults only.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "“Os peptídeos bioativos de colágeno hidrolisado com peso molecular médio de 2 kDa auxiliam na manutenção da saúde da pele.”" (English: "“Bioactive hydrolysed collagen peptides with an average molecular weight of 2 kDa help maintain skin health.”") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, a compounded (magistral) preparation must be made individually by the pharmacy against a prescription from an authorised professional that sets its composition, form and dosing (RDC 96/2008 definition).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "PREPARAÇÃO MAGISTRAL - É aquela preparada na farmácia, de forma individualizada, para ser dispensada atendendo a uma prescrição de um profissional habilitado, respeitada a legislação vigente, que estabelece sua composição, forma farmacêutica, posologia e modo de usar." (English: "MAGISTRAL PREPARATION – One prepared in the pharmacy, individually, to be dispensed against a prescription from an authorised professional, in accordance with current legislation, which sets its composition, dosage form, dosing and directions for use.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated on 2 Jul 2026 that any substance must have undergone efficacy and safety assessment before it can be compounded, and that compounding may only be individual, on a medical prescription, by a compounding pharmacy licensed by local health surveillance.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Para ser manipulada, qualquer substância precisa ter passado por análises de eficácia e segurança. Além disso, a manipulação de qualquer fórmula SÓ pode ocorrer de forma individualizada, com apresentação de receita médica, por farmácias de manipulação que estejam devidamente regularizadas na vigilância sanitária local." (English: "To be compounded, any substance must have undergone efficacy and safety assessments. In addition, compounding of any formula may ONLY take place individually, on presentation of a medical prescription, by compounding pharmacies duly licensed by local health surveillance.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated in Nov 2024 that compounded medicines should be used only when the registered industrial product is unavailable in the dose or dosage form the patient needs, and that only APIs with a current or past registration may be compounded into hormonal implants.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "A Anvisa ressalta que medicamentos manipulados devem ser utilizados somente diante da indisponibilidade do produto industrializado, registrado na Agência, na dosagem ou forma farmacêutica específica necessária ao paciente, e a partir de avaliação e da prescrição do profissional médico responsável." (English: "Anvisa stresses that compounded medicines should be used only when the industrialised product registered with the Agency is unavailable in the specific dose or dosage form the patient needs, and following assessment and prescription by the responsible physician.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, Nota Técnica 200/2025 (Aug 2025) allows compounding of GLP-1 agonists only in narrow conditions: synthetic APIs only if a registered medicine with the same molecule exists, biotech APIs only from the manufacturer assessed at registration, with mandatory quality testing; at that date synthetic semaglutide could not be imported or compounded.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "No caso dos IFAs obtidos por síntese química, a manipulação é permitida desde que já existam medicamentos registrados no Brasil com a mesma molécula. … Por exemplo, atualmente, a semaglutida possui registro apenas como produto biotecnológico. Portanto, não é permitida a importação nem a manipulação da semaglutida sintética até que exista um medicamento registrado com o IFA sintético." (English: "For APIs obtained by chemical synthesis, compounding is permitted provided registered medicines with the same molecule already exist in Brazil. … For example, semaglutide is currently registered only as a biotechnological product. Therefore, import and compounding of synthetic semaglutide are not permitted until a medicine with the synthetic API is registered.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated in Apr 2025 that its measure does not change the physician's right to prescribe medicines for purposes other than those on the label (off-label use), when the physician considers that, for a given patient, the benefits outweigh the risks.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "A medida não altera o direito do profissional médico de prescrever medicamentos para finalidades diferentes das descritas na bula. Essa prática, conhecida como uso "off label", acontece quando o médico entende que, para determinado paciente, os benefícios do tratamento superam os riscos." (English: "The measure does not change the physician's right to prescribe medicines for purposes other than those described in the label. This practice, known as "off-label" use, occurs when the physician considers that, for a given patient, the benefits of treatment outweigh the risks.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, no medicine, including an imported one, may be manufactured, sold or supplied before it is registered (Law 6.360/1976, art. 12).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Art. 12 - Nenhum dos produtos de que trata esta Lei, inclusive os importados, poderá ser industrializado, exposto à venda ou entregue ao consumo antes de registrado no Ministério da Saúde." (English: "Art. 12 – None of the products covered by this Law, including imported ones, may be manufactured, offered for sale or supplied for consumption before being registered with the Ministry of Health.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated on 2 Jul 2026 that some injectable peptides are not regularised in any category (food, medicine, cosmetic or supplement) and are therefore illegal for any health use, including aesthetic use.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Não à toa, alguns peptídeos injetáveis NÃO estão regularizados na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa) em nenhuma categoria - alimento, medicamento, cosmético, suplemento alimentar -, ou seja, são ILEGAIS para qualquer uso em saúde, inclusive estético." (English: "Not surprisingly, some injectable peptides are NOT regularised with the National Health Surveillance Agency (Anvisa) in any category – food, medicine, cosmetic, food supplement – that is, they are ILLEGAL for any health use, including aesthetic use.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated in Jul 2026 that an investigational (experimental) medicine is used exclusively in authorised clinical research.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "O medicamento experimental, também chamado de medicamento investigacional, é utilizado exclusivamente em pesquisas clínicas autorizadas." (English: "An experimental medicine, also called an investigational medicine, is used exclusively in authorised clinical research.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, unregistered medicines may be imported only exceptionally, for strictly personal use, with a medical prescription; when ANVISA publishes a specific prohibition (as for several GLP-1 pens in 2025–2026), import by any route is suspended.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Medicamentos sem registro no Brasil só podem ser importados de forma excepcional e para uso exclusivamente pessoal, mediante prescrição médica e o cumprimento de requisitos adicionais. Porém, nos casos em que a Anvisa publica proibição específica, a importação, por qualquer modalidade, também fica suspensa." (English: "Medicines without registration in Brazil may only be imported exceptionally and for exclusively personal use, on medical prescription and subject to additional requirements. However, where Anvisa publishes a specific prohibition, import by any route is also suspended.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated in Sep 2025 that use of an unregistered imported medicine is entirely the responsibility of the patient and the prescribing physician.

Seu uso é de inteira responsabilidade do paciente e do médico prescritor, além do risco de falsificação no mercado internacional." (English: "Another warning: medicines without registration in Brazil have not had their safety and efficacy assessed by the Agency. Their use is the entire responsibility of the patient and the prescribing physician, besides the risk of falsification on the international market.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, cosmetic labelling may not carry therapeutic claims for the product or its ingredients (RDC 907/2024, art. 12), so a peptide serum that claims to treat a condition falls outside the cosmetic category.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Art. 12. A rotulagem não deve conter nome comercial, marcas, imagens, links eletrônicos ou dizeres que: … II - representem alegações terapêuticas atribuídas ao uso do produto ou de seus ingredientes" (English: "Art. 12. Labelling must not contain trade names, brands, images, electronic links or wording that: … II – represent therapeutic claims attributed to the use of the product or its ingredients") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA stated on 2 Jul 2026 that injectable cosmetics do not exist; an injectable product offered as a cosmetic is irregular. Topical products named after GHK-Cu do appear as notified cosmetics in ANVISA's cosmetics dataset (221 entries, 25 Sep 2026); ANVISA cancelled several GHK-Cu cosmetic processes on 29 Apr 2026 without published reasons (RE 1.771/2026).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Por fim, apesar de suposta finalidade estética, esses produtos também NÃO são cosméticos. Não existem cosméticos injetáveis e, se o produto é oferecido desta forma, trata-se de cosmético irregular." (English: "Finally, despite their supposed aesthetic purpose, these products are also NOT cosmetics. Injectable cosmetics do not exist and, if the product is offered in this form, it is an irregular cosmetic.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, a food supplement is by definition a product for oral ingestion for healthy people (RDC 243/2018), so no injectable supplement can exist.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "VII - suplemento alimentar: produto para ingestão oral, apresentado em formas farmacêuticas, destinado a suplementar a alimentação de indivíduos saudáveis com nutrientes, substâncias bioativas, enzimas ou probióticos, isolados ou combinados." (English: "VII – food supplement: a product for oral ingestion, presented in pharmaceutical forms, intended to supplement the diet of healthy individuals with nutrients, bioactive substances, enzymes or probiotics, alone or combined.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, the constituents a food supplement may use are those on ANVISA's authorised list (IN 28/2018); constituents not on the list must not be used.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Os constituintes autorizados constam da lista aprovada na IN 28/2018 e são diferentes para os seguintes grupos etários: 0 a 3 anos (Anexo II) e acima de 3 anos (Anexo I). … Constituintes que não constem dessa lista não devem ser utilizados." (English: "Authorised constituents are on the list approved in IN 28/2018 and differ for the following age groups: 0 to 3 years (Annex II) and over 3 years (Annex I). … Constituents not on this list must not be used.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, promotion of prescription-only medicines is restricted to media aimed exclusively at professionals who can prescribe or dispense them, and online promotion must sit behind a registration wall for those professionals (RDC 96/2008, arts 27 and 29).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Art. 29 A propaganda ou publicidade de medicamentos de venda sob prescrição veiculada na internet deve ser acessível, exclusivamente, aos profissionais habilitados a prescrever ou dispensar medicamentos, por meio de sistema de cadastramento eletrônico" (English: "Art. 29 Advertising or publicity of prescription-only medicines on the internet must be accessible exclusively to professionals authorised to prescribe or dispense medicines, through an electronic registration system") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, compounding pharmacies may give only prescribers factual material naming active substances and referenced indications, with no brand names, prices or promotional content (RDC 96/2008, art. 36); ANVISA restated in Nov 2024 that advertising compounded products to the public is not permitted.
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "A norma também reforçou a proibição da propaganda de produtos manipulados para o público em geral, o que não é permitido na legislação atual." claims.text: In Brazil, since 23 Jun 2025 all GLP-1 agonist medicines (semaglutide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, tirzepatide and others), industrial or compounded, need a two-copy prescription valid 90 days that the pharmacy retains (RDC 973/2025 and IN 360/2025).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "A Instrução Normativa-IN nº 360 e a Resolução da Diretoria Colegiada - RDC nº 973 foram publicadas em 24 de abril de 2025, e entrarão em vigor 60 (sessenta) dias após essa data. (English: "Normative Instruction IN 360 and Collegiate Board Resolution RDC 973 were published on 24 April 2025 and enter into force 60 (sixty) days after that date. Thus, the new measures on GLP-1 receptor agonists apply from 23 June 2025.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: In Brazil, the Federal Council of Medicine bars physicians from using anabolic steroids or androgens for aesthetic purposes or performance, and from prescribing hormones marketed as "bioidentical" or "nano" without proof of superiority (CFM Resolution 2.333/2023, in force since its publication on 11 Apr 2023; listed as in force on 25 Sep 2026).
claims.reviewNote: primary source quote: "Art. 3º São vedados no exercício da Medicina, por serem destituídos de comprovação científica suficiente quanto ao seu benefício e segurança para o ser humano, o uso e a divulgação dos seguintes procedimentos: … II – Utilização de formulações de esteroides anabolizantes ou hormônios androgênicos com a finalidade estética; … IV – A prescrição de hormônios divulgados como “bioidênticos”, em formulação “nano” ou nomenclaturas de cunho comercial e sem a devida comprovação científica de superioridade clínica para a finalidade prevista nesta resolução." (English: "Art. 3 The following procedures are prohibited in medical practice, lacking sufficient scientific proof of benefit and safety for humans, as are their use and promotion: … II – Use of formulations of anabolic steroids or androgenic hormones for aesthetic purposes; … IV – The prescription of hormones promoted as “bioidentical”, in “nano” formulation or under commercial names, without due scientific proof of clinical superiority for the purpose set out in this resolution.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

Utilização de hormônios, em qualquer formulação, inclusive o hormônio de crescimento, exceto nas situações de deficiências diagnosticadas cuja reposição mostra evidências de benefícios cientificamente comprovados;" (English: "III. claims.text: In Brazil, ANVISA inspections between Jan and Apr 2026 led to interdiction of 8 of the 26 compounding pharmacies and importers assessed and seized over 1.3 million irregular injectable units; ANVISA and the Federal Police issued a joint technical note on 6 May 2026 on crimes involving irregular GLP-1 medicines.

(English: "Inspections by Anvisa between January and April led to the closure of 8 of the 26 establishments assessed, as well as the seizure of more than 1.3 million units of irregular injectable medicines and more than 11 prohibition measures on the import, trade and use of these products.") · grader: research agents under the jurisdiction research brief; statements are regulatory facts, graded context

claims.text: Human evidence on facial change during incretin-driven weight loss is observational and small: a retrospective imaging study of 20 patients found a median 9% loss of midface volume, mostly superficial and about 7% per 10 kg lost, and a survey of 1,226 patients found self-reported sagging, facial volume loss and hair loss rising with the percentage of weight lost. No randomized trial has measured facial fat, laxity or appearance as an outcome of semaglutide or tirzepatide (PubMed and ClinicalTrials.gov, September 2026); registered randomized trials test fillers and devices in people already on these drugs.

units.tutorContext: Module 1 teaches cutaneous neuro-immuno-endocrine physiology with every finding labelled by evidence type (mechanism, human evidence, regulatory status, open question). The skin is described as four immuno-endocrine units (epidermal, dermal, hypodermal, adnexal) that signal locally, via sensory nerves and via the circulation (mechanism reviews, D). Skin cells express CYP11A1, 11β-HSD1, 5α-reductase and aromatase and make cortisol, DHT and estradiol locally (cell/tissue work, D); human scalp follicles run an HPA-like loop with cortisol secretion and CRH feedback ex vivo (Ito 2005) and a GH/IGF-1 loop ex vivo (Horesh 2023); keratinocyte glucocorticoids restrain skin inflammation in mice (Phan 2021); the thyroid-like loop is mostly mouse data. Three directions: local loop; body to skin (Cushing striae, hypothyroid skin); skin to body (vitamin D3 released into the circulation, established human physiology; a skin contribution to circulating sex steroids per reviews). Refer systemic patterns promptly (violaceous striae with new hypertension or diabetes, rapid virilisation), per the Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology guide. The Hormone Cell Atlas (Fei, Huang-Doran et al., Science 2026) read RNA of 379 hormone/receptor genes in ~14 million cells and nuclei from 47 tissues incl. skin; its authors call the predictions putative and hypothesis-generating: RNA is not protein, secretion or clinical effect. The guide's pearl that serum 25(OH)D falls with sunscreen use is not borne out by field trials of daily moderate-SPF sunscreen (Neale 2019, C; high SPF untested); never advise dropping sun protection. Senescence: p16-positive cells rise with age in human epidermis and dermis (C) and track with wrinkles and perceived age (Waaijer 2016, n=178, association, C); the SASP was defined in cultured cells (D); an MMP-1 collagen-fragmentation loop is shown in aged human dermis plus culture (D), with senescent cells a plausible, unproven driver; clearing senescent cells extends healthy lifespan in mice (D); human senotherapy data are small biomarker pilots (Hickson 2019 open-label n=9, D; Chung 2019 topical rapamycin exploratory RCT, C); no randomized trial with clinical skin-ageing outcomes (checked Sept 2026); the guide confines senolytics to trials. Levers with human trials: daily sunscreen (Hughes 2013, n=903, B), topical tretinoin for photoageing (GRADE A), retinol in very old skin (Kafi 2007, C). Never give doses, concentrations, regimens or sourcing; adapt 'what you do next' to the learner's role (prescriber, clinical staff, advisor) without changing evidence. No CME credit is currently offered.

videoTranscript.en: This course starts with physiology, because every later question about a hormone or peptide for skin rests on it. Skin senses hormones from the blood, makes several of its own, and ages in ways that change both. Think of the skin as a sensing organ with its own hormone supply. Researchers who study it describe four units, epidermal, dermal, hypodermal and adnexal, the last meaning hair follicles and glands. Each unit holds cells that can make hormones and mount an immune response, such as keratinocytes, fibroblasts, sebocytes, fat cells and mast cells. Signals move three ways. Neighbouring cells talk directly, sensory nerves carry messages in and out, and some products enter the blood and reach distant organs. Keep one distinction in view for the whole module. A signal that is made and used inside the skin is a local loop. A hormone that arrives from the blood, or leaves the skin for the rest of the body, is systemic signalling.
videoTranscript.id: Kursus ini dimulai dengan fisiologi, karena setiap pertanyaan lanjutan mengenai hormon atau peptida untuk kulit berlandaskan padanya. Kulit mendeteksi hormon dari darah, memproduksi beberapa hormonnya sendiri, dan menua melalui mekanisme yang mengubah keduanya. Pandanglah kulit sebagai organ pengindera dengan suplai hormonnya sendiri. Para peneliti yang mempelajarinya mendeskripsikan empat unit: epidermal, dermal, hipodermal, dan adneksa—yang terakhir mencakup folikel rambut dan kelenjar. Setiap unit mengandung sel-sel yang mampu memproduksi hormon dan memicu respons imun, seperti keratinosit, fibroblas, sebosit, sel lemak (adiposit), dan sel mast. Sinyal bergerak melalui tiga jalur. Sel-sel yang berdekatan berkomunikasi secara langsung, saraf sensorik membawa pesan masuk dan keluar, dan beberapa produk memasuki aliran darah hingga mencapai organ yang jauh. Pegang satu pembeda penting ini di sepanjang modul: Sinyal yang diproduksi dan digunakan di dalam kulit adalah loop lokal (local loop). Hormon yang tiba dari darah, atau meninggalkan kulit menuju bagian tubuh lainnya, adalah persinyalan sistemik (systemic signalling).

body.en: Recent reviews describe the skin as a neuro-immuno-endocrine organ built from four units: epidermal, dermal, hypodermal and adnexal (hair follicles and glands). Each holds cells that can make hormones and mount an immune response. They signal to neighbouring cells, through sensory nerves, and through the blood. Most of this picture comes from cell, tissue and animal studies.

Masing-masing unit memiliki sel yang mampu memproduksi hormon dan memicu respons imun. Sel-sel ini mengirimkan sinyal ke sel tetangga, melalui saraf sensorik, dan melalui sirkulasi darah. Sebagian besar gambaran ini diperoleh dari studi sel, jaringan, dan hewan.

title.en: A steroid factory with local axes.

body.en: Skin cells carry the enzymes to build steroids from cholesterol or to activate precursors arriving in the blood, and they run shortened copies of the body's central hormone axes. Each row names the evidence it rests on, because most of it comes from cells, tissue kept alive outside the body, or mice.
body.id: Sel-sel kulit memiliki enzim untuk membentuk steroid dari kolesterol atau mengaktifkan prekursor yang dibawa oleh darah, serta menjalankan salinan berskala kecil dari aksis hormon sentral tubuh. Setiap baris mencantumkan bukti ilmiah yang mendasarinya, karena sebagian besar berasal dari sel, jaringan yang dipertahankan hidup di luar tubuh (ex vivo), atau mencit.

label.id: Putaran menyerupai tiroid (thyroid-like loop)

note.en: Keratinocyte growth and the hair cycle. Mostly mouse models.
note.id: Pertumbuhan keratinosit dan siklus rambut. Sebagian besar model mencit.

label.id: Putaran somatotropik

note.en: Human hair follicles, ex vivo.
note.id: Folikel rambut manusia, ex vivo.

label.id: Melanokortin

note.en: Pigment, barrier and local immune restraint. Module 05 returns to this.
note.id: Pigmen, sawar, dan kendali imun lokal. Modul 05 membahas kembali hal ini.

callout.en: A local axis explains biology. The Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology guide calls it foundation, not a dosing rationale.
callout.id: Aksis lokal menjelaskan aspek biologis. Panduan Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology menyebutnya sebagai fondasi, bukan rasional penentuan dosis.

body.en: Hormone signals in skin run in three directions. Some are made and used in the same patch of skin. Some arrive from the blood. A few leave the skin and act on the rest of the body. Knowing which one you are looking at decides whether the answer lies in the skin or in a systemic assessment.
body.id: Sinyal hormon pada kulit berjalan dalam tiga arah. Sebagian diproduksi dan digunakan pada area kulit yang sama. Sebagian tiba dari sirkulasi darah. Sebagian kecil keluar dari kulit dan bekerja pada bagian tubuh lainnya. Mengetahui arah mana yang sedang Anda amati menentukan apakah solusinya terletak pada kulit atau pada evaluasi sistemik.

value.en: Made and used in the skin

note.en: Between neighbouring cells, back on the same cell, or inside it
note.id: Antarsel yang bertetangga, kembali ke sel yang sama, atau di dalam sel tersebut

label.id: Tubuh ke kulit

value.en: A circulating hormone acting on skin
value.id: Hormon sirkulasi yang bekerja pada kulit

note.en: The skin finding can be the visible sign of a systemic disorder
note.id: Temuan kulit dapat menjadi tanda klinis yang terlihat dari suatu gangguan sistemik

label.id: Kulit ke tubuh

value.en: A skin product entering the circulation

note.en: The skin acting as an endocrine gland for other organs
note.id: Kulit yang bertindak sebagai kelenjar endokrin bagi organ lain

callout.en: Before you treat a skin finding, decide which direction it runs.
callout.id: Sebelum Anda menangani suatu temuan kulit, tentukan arah jalur sinyalnya.

prompt.en: One finding at a time: which way does the signal run?
prompt.id: Satu temuan demi satu temuan: ke arah mana sinyal tersebut berjalan?

label.id: Loop lokal
Tubuh ke kulit
Kulit ke tubuh

label.en: Keratinocytes make cortisol that restrains immune cells in the same patch of skin
label.id: Keratinosit memproduksi kortisol yang menahan sel-sel imun pada area kulit yang sama

why.en: Local loop. Made and used where it is produced; the functional proof comes from mice that cannot make it in keratinocytes and develop skin inflammation.
why.id: Loop lokal. Diproduksi dan digunakan di tempat pembuatannya; bukti fungsional berasal dari mencit yang tidak dapat memproduksinya di keratinosit dan mengalami inflamasi kulit.

label.en: UVB turns 7-dehydrocholesterol into vitamin D3, which the blood carries to the liver
label.id: UVB mengubah 7-dehidrokolesterol menjadi vitamin D3, yang kemudian dibawa oleh darah ke hati

why.en: Skin to body. Vitamin D3 made in the skin is released into the circulation and activated elsewhere. Established human physiology.
why.id: Kulit ke tubuh. Vitamin D3 yang diproduksi di kulit dilepaskan ke dalam sirkulasi dan diaktifkan di tempat lain. Fisiologi manusia yang telah mapan.

label.en: Violaceous striae, thin skin and easy bruising in Cushing syndrome
label.id: Striae violasea, kulit tipis, dan mudah memar pada sindrom Cushing

why.en: Body to skin. Systemic cortisol excess acting on the dermis. The Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology guide lists suspected Cushing syndrome as a reason to refer promptly.
why.id: Tubuh ke kulit. Kelebihan kortisol sistemik yang bekerja pada dermis. Panduan Aesthetic & Regenerative Endocrinology mencantumkan kecurigaan sindrom Cushing sebagai alasan untuk segera merujuk.

label.en: Scalp hair follicles kept alive in culture secrete cortisol, then switch off their own CRH
label.id: Folikel rambut kulit kepala yang dipertahankan tetap hidup dalam kultur mensekresikan kortisol, kemudian menghentikan produksi CRH-nya sendiri

why.en: Local loop, with its own feedback, running with no blood supply or nerves attached. Human tissue, ex vivo.
why.id: Loop lokal, dengan umpan balik mandiri, berjalan tanpa adanya suplai darah atau saraf yang terhubung. Jaringan manusia, ex vivo.

label.en: Skin converts circulating precursors into androgens and estrogens that add to the body's supply
label.id: Kulit mengonversi prekursor sirkulasi menjadi androgen dan estrogen yang menambah pasokan tubuh

why.en: Skin to body. Reviews describe a skin contribution to circulating sex steroids, more so in older people; the evidence is mainly biochemical.
why.id: Kulit ke tubuh. Berbagai tinjauan pustaka menjelaskan kontribusi kulit terhadap steroid seks sirkulasi, terutama pada individu lanjut usia; buktinya sebagian besar bersifat biokimiawi.

label.en: Dry, coarse skin and myxoedema in hypothyroidism
label.id: Kulit kering dan kasar serta miksedema pada hipotiroidisme

why.en: Body to skin. Circulating thyroid hormone sets epidermal turnover and dermal matrix; the skin signs track the systemic deficit.
why.id: Tubuh ke kulit. Hormon tiroid sirkulasi mengatur turnover epidermis dan matriks dermis; tanda-tanda pada kulit mencerminkan defisit sistemik tersebut.

label.en: Scalp follicles convert testosterone to DHT, which shrinks susceptible follicles
label.id: Folikel kulit kepala mengonversi testosteron menjadi DHT, yang mengecilkan folikel yang rentan

why.en: Local loop. 5α-reductase in the pilosebaceous unit makes DHT where it acts; the guide names it the substrate of acne, androgenetic alopecia and hirsutism.
why.id: Loop lokal. 5α-reduktase pada unit pilosebasea memproduksi DHT di tempat ia bekerja; panduan ini menyebutnya sebagai substrat dari akne, alopesia androgenetik, dan hirsutisme.

done.en: Seven placed. Three local loops, two signals the skin sends out, and two it receives.
done.id: Tujuh telah ditempatkan. Tiga loop lokal, dua sinyal yang dikirimkan oleh kulit, dan dua sinyal yang diterimanya.
